en: I've seen other Toshino too, but that's no doubt about it. What the-

jp: なぜ45年前にだけ文化祭を考える会が開かれたのか
rm: Naze 45 nen mae ni dake bunkasai wo kangaeru kai ga hirakareta no ka
en: Why was it only 45 years ago that we had the opportunity to think about a cultural festival?

jp: おそらく、生徒からの強い要求があったからだ
rm: Osoraku, seito kara no tsuyoi youkyuu ga attakara da
en: It's probably because there was a strong request from the student. The hint is...

jp: ヒントは評価にある
rm: Hint wa hyouka ni aru
en: The hint is in the evaluation.

jp: ここだ
rm: Koko da
en: It's here.

jp: この1年で先輩は英雄から伝説になった
rm: Kono 1 nen de senpai wa eiyuu kara densetsu ni natta
en: In this one year, Senpai has become a legend from a hero. The cultural festival is over.

jp: 文化祭は今年も5日間盛大に行われる
rm: Bunkasai wa kotoshi mo 5 kakan seidai ni okonawareru
en: The cultural festival will be held for 5 days this year as well. The point is...

jp: ポイントは行われるじゃなく、5日間の方にあると思う
rm: Point wa okonawareruja naku, 5 kakan no hou ni aru to omou
en: I don't think the points will be made, but it will be in the next 5 days.

jp: どういうこと?
rm: Dou iu koto?
en: What do you mean? In five days...

jp: 5日間っていうのが、英雄関谷純の専科だってことさ
rm: 5 kakan tte iu no ga, eiyuu Sekiya Jun no senka da tte koto sa
en: In five days, the hero Sekitani Jun will be on the battlefield.

jp: これは推測だが、この校長の学力重視宣言と合わせて考えると
rm: Kore wa suisoku daga, kono kouchou no gakuryoku juushi sengen to awasete kangaeru to

jp: 校長は平日に5日間もある文化祭を縮小しようとしたんじゃないか
rm: Kouchou wa heijitsu ni 5 kakan mo aru bunkasai wo shukushou shiyou to shita n ja nai ka
en: I think the principal is trying to shorten the five-day cultural festival on weekdays. But...

jp: だから、全学があれほど怒りに燃え上がったんだろう
rm: Dakara, zengaku ga are hodo ikari ni moeagatta n darou
en: That's why the whole school was so angry.

jp: これが事件の原因、なぜだ
rm: Kore ga jiken no gen'in, naze da
en: This is the cause of the incident. Why?

jp: で実際の行動、どのように
rm: De jissai no koudou, dono you ni
en: So, how does it work?

jp: 古典部部長関谷純くんの英雄的指導に支えられた
rm: Koten bu buchou Sekiya Junkun no eiyuuteki shidou ni sasaerareta

jp: 過感なる実行主義が行われた
rm: Kakan naru jikkou shugi ga okonawareta

jp: 最後の何をに繋がるな
rm: Saigo no nan wo ni tsunagaru na
en: It's connected to the last Nanyo.

jp: 生徒たちは暴力は振るわなかった
rm: Seitotachi wa bouryoku wa furuwanakatta

jp: やってもボイコットくらいだろう
rm: Yatte mo boycott kurai darou
en: Even if you do it, it's like a boycott, isn't it? School

jp: 学校側は仕方なく生徒側と話し合い、文化祭縮小を断念した
rm: Gakkou gawa wa shikatanaku seito gawa to hanashiai, bunkasai shukushou wo dannen shita
en: The school had no choice but to talk to the students and decided to cancel the cultural festival.

jp: だがその代償として、英雄関谷純を退学にした
rm: Daga sono daishou to shite, eiyuu Sekiya Jun wo taigaku ni shita
en: However, as a reward, the hero, Sekitani Jun, was expelled from school.

jp: 事件と退学の時期がなんでずれてるか
rm: Jiken to taigaku no jiki ga nan de zureteru ka
en: What's the difference between the time of the case and the time of the university?

jp: 関谷純を退学にしたら、騒動はますます大きくなる
rm: Sekiya Jun wo taigaku ni shitara, soudou wa masumasu ookiku naru

jp: だから熱狂が収まる頃、文化祭の後にしたんじゃないか
rm: Dakara nekkyou ga osamaru koro, bunkasai no ato ni shita n ja nai ka
en: That's why when the heat subsided, I think it was after the cultural festival.

jp: 俺のまとめは以上だ
rm: Ore no matome wa ijou da
en: That's all I have to say. Yanji...

jp: 45年前、おじにそんなことが…
rm: 45 nen mae, oji ni sonna koto ga...
en: 45 years ago, that kind of thing happened to my uncle... As expected...

jp: さすがです、オレキさん
rm: Sasuga desu, Orekisan
en: As expected of you, Oreki-san.

jp: いや、なかなかお見事だったよホータロウ
rm: Iya, nakanaka omigoto datta yo hou Tarou
en: Well, that was quite impressive, Houtarou. I see.

jp: うん、なるほどだ
rm: Un, naruhodo da
en: Yeah, I see. Again?

jp: またオレキが、信じられない
rm: Mata ore kiga, shinjirarenai
en: I can't believe it!

jp: たまたまだ
rm: Tamatama da
en: It's just a coincidence.

jp: みなさん、質問はありますか?
rm: Minasan, shitsumon wa arimasu ka?
en: Everyone, do you have any questions?

jp: 意義なし
rm: Igi nashi
en: Do you understand? It's meaningless!

jp: 悔しいけど当たってると思う
rm: Kuyashiikedo atatteru to omou
en: It's meaningless. I'm sorry, but I think you're right.

jp: では、今のオレキさんの説を軸に、今年の文集を作っていきましょう
rm: De wa, ima no Orekisan no setsu wo jiku ni, kotoshi no bunshuu wo tsukutte ikimashou
en: Well then, let's make this year's analysis based on the theory of the current Orekki-san.

jp: 詳しい内容はまた後日ですね
rm: Kuwashii naiyou wa mata gojitsu desu ne
en: Ah, I'll tell you more about that later.

jp: それでは解散です、お疲れ様でした
rm: Sore de wa kaisan desu, otsukaresama deshita
en: Well then, it's time to go. Thank you for your hard work.

jp: 本当にありがとうございました
rm: Hontou ni arigatou gozaimashita
en: Thank you very much.

jp: 俺だけでやったことじゃないさ
rm: Ore dake de yatta koto ja nai sa
en: I'm not the only one who did it.

jp: いいえ、オレキさんのおかげです
rm: Iie, Orekisan no okage desu
en: No, it's all thanks to you, Orekki.

jp: かさ、貸してもらって悪いな、じゃ、また
rm: Ka sa, kashite moratte warui na, ja, mata
en: It's all thanks to you. I'm sorry I let you borrow my umbrella. See you later.

jp: だったら私は、どうして、泣いたのでしょうか
rm: Dattara watakushi wa, dou shite, naita no deshou ka
en: See you later. But, if that's the case, why did I cry?
